translationRepairs: Packet s0090 reads 廆懼，首服, but CText Jinshu 載記第八 has 燾懼，首服 after Hui threatens nephew 燾; parallel editions likewise make Tao submit. Idiomatic "Bi" invents Cui Bi, and "Tao groveled in terror" restores the correct subject.
Same corrupt packet 廆懼; CText and parallel witnesses read 燾懼，首服, so the literal must name Tao, not Bi, as the one who submitted under threat.
Hui's reign disasters enabled Shi Le.
Late Emperor Hui's disasters enabled Shi Le.
惠皇之末 names Western Jin Emperor Hui (惠皇), not Murong Hui; bare "Hui's reign" in this Murong chapter misidentifies the referent, and "Late Emperor Hui" matches 惠皇之末.

He promoted worthies to routine administration: Hedong Pei Yi, Dai commandery Lu Chang, Beiping Yang Dan as strategists; Beihai Feng Xian, Guangping You Sui, Beiping Fang Qian, Bohai Feng Chou, Xihe Song Shi, Hedong Pei Kai as arms and legs; Bohai Feng Yi, Pingyuan Song Gai, Anding Huangfu Qi, Lanling Miao Kai held literary portfolios; Kuaiji Zhu Zuoche, Taishan Humu Yi, Lu state Kong Zuan served as honored guests; Pingyuan Liu Zan's erudition made him Libationer of the eastern school where heir Huang studied.

He promoted worthies to routine administration: Hedong Pei Yi, Dai commandery Lu Chang, Beiping Yang Dan as strategists; Beihai Feng Xian, Guangping You Sui, Beiping Xifang Qian, Bohai Feng Chou, Xihe Song Shi, Hedong Pei Kai as arms and legs; Bohai Feng Yi, Pingyuan Song Gai, Anding Huangfu Ji, Lanling Miao Kai held literary portfolios; Kuaiji Zhu Zuoche, Taishan Humu Yi, Lu state Kong Zuan served as honored guests; Pingyuan Liu Zan's erudition made him Libationer of the eastern school where heir Huang studied.

北平西方虔 is the compound surname Xifang, so "Fang Qian" is wrong and the proposal's "Xifang Qian" is right; the same literal still misreads 皇甫岌 as "Huangfu Qi," which must be "Huangfu Ji" as in the idiomatic and name claims.

Literal wraps Tao Kan's quoted gist in broken backslash escapes; restoring ordinary quotation marks around the 其略曰 speech fixes the corruption without altering content.
